verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OCR results returned in open formats such as markdown, HTML and JSON, plus a self-hosted deployment option. Those are processing-output formats and deployment choices, not a documented capability to export all account data (uploaded files, stored results, annotations, batch outputs) and leave the service. With no data-export or portability feature in the pack, this applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
